title: AWS disaster recovery overview
text:
AWS disaster recovery uses cross-region replication of storage volumes.

The pilot light pattern keeps a minimal copy running in a second region and scales up during failover.

title: AWS recovery objectives
text:
With continuous replication the AWS recovery point objective (RPO) is typically under one minute.

Recovery time objective (RTO) for warm standby is about fifteen minutes.

title: AWS backup vaults
text:
AWS backup vaults store snapshots with a configurable retention period.

Vault lock prevents deletion of backups before retention ends.

title: AWS replication pricing
text:
Cross-region replication on AWS is billed per gigabyte transferred.

Standby compute in the recovery region is billed at the normal hourly rate.

title: AWS regions
text: AWS regions are isolated geographic areas with multiple availability zones.

title: Internal AWS failover runbook
text:
Internal disaster recovery failover runbook for AWS: page the on-call engineer before promoting the replica.

RPO target for tier zero systems is zero.

title: Azure disaster recovery overview
text:
Azure disaster recovery replicates virtual machines to a paired region.

Failover is orchestrated by recovery plans that start machines in a defined order.

title: Azure recovery objectives
text:
Azure replication offers a recovery point objective (RPO) of about thirty seconds for supported disks.

Recovery time objective (RTO) depends on the size of the recovery plan.

title: Azure backup
text: Azure backup keeps recovery points in a vault with soft delete enabled by default.

title: Azure replication pricing
text:
Azure charges a monthly fee per protected instance for disaster recovery replication.

Storage for replicas is billed separately.

title: Azure region pairs
text: Azure region pairs are updated one at a time to reduce the chance of simultaneous outages.

title: GCP disaster recovery overview
text:
GCP disaster recovery relies on regional persistent disks replicated synchronously across two zones.

For regional failover, snapshots are copied to a second region on a schedule.

title: GCP recovery objectives
text:
Synchronous zonal replication on GCP gives a recovery point objective (RPO) of zero within a region.

Cross-region recovery time objective (RTO) is bounded by snapshot restore time.

title: GCP backup and DR service
text: The GCP backup and DR service manages snapshot schedules and retention policies.

title: GCP replication pricing
text:
GCP bills regional persistent disks at twice the zonal disk price.

Snapshot storage is billed per gigabyte per month.

title: GCP regions and zones
text: GCP regions contain three or more zones connected by low latency links.

title: RPO and RTO explained
text:
Recovery point objective (RPO) is the maximum acceptable data loss measured in time.

Recovery time objective (RTO) is the maximum acceptable downtime.

title: Disaster recovery patterns
text:
Common disaster recovery patterns are backup and restore, pilot light, warm standby and multi-site active.

Cost rises as RPO and RTO shrink.

title: Testing failover
text: Failover should be tested regularly with game days that simulate a full regional outage.

title: Encryption at rest
text: Encryption at rest protects replicated data using keys held in a managed key service.
